correctness.rationale: The standalone standard-library checker independently enumerates all 332 faces twice, computes complete GF(2) boundary ranks, verifies the 158-pair discrete Morse matching on all 975 Hasse incidences, and computes the exact signed 7x7 cellular boundary by integral unit pivots. Three nonzero rows summing to zero give rank at most two; a -1 minor forces rank two and primitive cancellation. The simply connected two-skeleton and Hurewicz identification show a genuine 5S2+5S3 wedge. Full 120-element S5 characters are derived from exact signed chain and image traces with unambiguous modular reconstruction.

value.rationale: A natural finite graph invariant of the canonical symmetric Petersen graph is determined integrally, not just over a field. A second, structurally meaningful computation distinguishes two equal-rank homology groups as inequivalent S5 modules, one irreducible and the other a sign-twisted permutation module, and shows the absence of invariant cycles. This addresses topology and symmetry simultaneously rather than an arbitrary small numerical slice.
